about.text: The best-known brunost: a sweet brown cheese boiled down from cow and goat milk, cream and whey.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Whey, milk and cream are boiled down carefully for several hours until the water has evaporated and the milk sugar has caramelised; goat's milk gives the stronger taste. No temperatures or times are given in the sources opened. Note: the 144 g figure is as written on no.wikipedia, which calls the goat milk 'pasteurisert geitemelk'; and it says cheese is whey + goat milk + cream + milk.
